text:
ana: heads-up: canary for the new lightweight streaming sampler made partial-frame counts drop to near-zero for a subset of tenants. noticed on ops dash at 06:03Z.
ben: was sampling toggled per-shard or global?
ravi: per-shard. low-traffic shards hit the light-proxy path that strips chunk headers to save CPU.
kat: consequence: console's "stream health" tile goes green because billing-accurate metric (`sse.partial_frames`) is absent. ops missed a real fragmentation issue. ena: typo? ben here. we also saw a small increase in resume retries which inflated short-window token counts.
ana: ana again. main asks: (1) differentiate health vs billing metrics, (2) prevent quota double-count on duplicate resumes, (3) make console surface when estimates are used.
ravi: telemetry plan: emit `proxy.partial_frames.estimated` when headers missing, and keep `sse.partial_frames` reserved for full proxies only. tag estimates with `estimate=true`.
kat: UI: add an icon/tooltip on the tile "using estimated partial-frame data" and an option to toggle showing billing-accurate only. reduce false green alerts. cc @product-ux
ben: routing change: make initial routing deterministic for first N seconds (tenant-configurable) so quotas anchor to a known billing path, then allow cheap fallthrough.
ravi: implement resume idempotency cache keying by `tenant:resume_id` with TTL 10s to dedupe quick replay storms. gate billing increments on acknowledgment from the model worker.
ana: owned tickets: ENG-STREAM-151 (telemetry split + header tags) assigned to ravi, ENG-STREAM-152 (resume dedupe + billing gate) assigned to ben, ENG-STREAM-153 (console indicator + toggle) assigned to kat.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: sampler-light-proxy v2 -> canary window 2026-03-23T08:00Z for 48h.
kat: add a console action to annotate time ranges with "rollout in progress" so alerts can auto-suppress for that shard. small UX win for ops.
ben: also push SDK guidance: add 50-200ms jitter before auto-resume when pooling TLS sockets to avoid synchronized resumes.
ravi: will add `x-rw-sampler: estimated=1` header for trace correlation.
nana: quick stopgap: create an alert for sudden drop in `sse.partial_frames` while `proxy.partial_frames.estimated` rises. that should surface the mismatch.
console-bot: created CF-STREAM-77 (show estimated vs billing metrics, add tooltip)
nana: ok team — let's run the canary with these telemetry shims first, iterate on console tiles after 24h data. post results to ENG-STREAM-151.
_archive_note: thread about sampler path causing missing partial-frame telemetry, routing and resume idempotency, console UX and telemetry split
